The child adopts for the Air Force the same 1949 courts-martial manual that C01 prescribed for the Army and reproduces nearly verbatim C01's effective-date provision and its complete three-part set of transitional safeguards for pending proceedings, previously nonpunishable conduct, and maximum punishment. C19 and C03 have weaker parallels involving Air Force substitutions and regulatory definitions, respectively, but neither approaches C01's distinctive textual identity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The said manual ... shall be in force and effect in the Department of the Air Force on and after February 1, 1949","parent_excerpt":"This manual shall be in force and effect in the Army of the United States on and after February 1, 1949","explanation":"The child adapts the parent's effective-date formula from the Army to the Air Force."},{"child_excerpt":"provided, that nothing contained in this manual shall be construed to invalidate any investigation, trial in which arraignment has been had, or other action begun prior to February 1, 1949;
